avis.titre: I will purchase this product forever. It has the magic !!!!!
avis.texte: After I wash my hair I put this magical potion on my hair. Sending gratitude to the people who developed it . I bought a lot of it because I am terrified you will take it off the market or try to make perfect better.
I have thick dry frizzy wavy hair. I put a lot of this on my hair. It's like a different head of hair. Beautiful.

avis.titre: Best hair mask I've found for my dry curly hair
avis.texte: I absolutely love this hair mask. I live in a dry climate and my hair is fine, curly (dry), color treated, and prone to knoting. I use this product almost everytime I wash my hair which is about once a week. I use this product on all of my hair including my roots so I can easily untangle it. It doesn't make my roots feel greasy like other hair masks. It makes all of my hair feel smooth and I'm able to brush it with few issues. It also helps with my dry scalp. With that being said if you're looking for a heavy/ greasy product to put on your ends this may not be the mask for you.

avis.titre: As I run my hand through my hair I think how silky my hair
avis.texte: I works!!!!! It does everything it said it would!! It doesn't get any better than that!!!!!!!!!

avis.titre: Didn't do much even as a basic conditioner
avis.texte: Title sums it up. I have long thick balayaged hair and was hopeful for this mask/conditioner and sadly just finished the entire tube and did not feel any conditioning nor softness. Sadly, there was no scent, either.
I've been using this for 3 months and repurchased because I'm hate us so healthy and shiny thanks to it (:
Moisturized and relieved my scalp as expected, will try as a mask for longer period of time

This quickly became my favorite hair mask ever. Doesn't weigh your hair down or make it look greasy, just makes it super soft, shiny, and more manageable if you tangle easily like me. My hair hasn't looked this healthy since I was a preteen. Many hair masks have also made my skin break out and that is not happening with this one.

avis.titre: A hyrdating masker that leaves your hair feeling soft & smoo
avis.texte: This is a good hydrating masker that left my curly hair feeling very soft & smooth. It had a faint vanilla smell that was amazing. I left the masker on my hair for 10 minutes as opposed to the 1-3 minutes that was suggested. My only complaint was that it didn't help with the frizziness of my hair.

I have fine color, treated hair and I am always looking for a deep conditioning mass to help me with my tangles and knots. This has quickly become one of my most reliable masks and I frequently bring it with me on vacation because I know I can trust it! I love the subtle light vanilla scent. It's so natural and not overpowering. I also think the long do you leave it on the better the results. This is now my fourth time are purchasing and I don't think I'll stop!￼

This has been so good for my processed hair! For context, I have medium to course hair, it's pretty thick with some waves, and I bleach with a 20 vol. every 6 weeks or so. I use this in conjunction with the DE Cocoamino Glossing shampoo, the Bumble and Bumble bond building treatment, and their BB Blonde purple conditioner once a week. Let me just say, this combo has been better then any other restorative routine I've ever used! It's a bit pricey all together but if you can do it, DO IT. Also- this can be used as a quick 10 minute mask, and over night mask, or a regular conditioner💙✨
Very good hair mask! Four stars just because I've had better hair masks before! 10/10 recommend though!!!!!

Okay, good job DE on sending me this deluxe sample! I'm absolutely purchasing this on my next order. After recently moving from the Sun and the sand to snow and bland… my hair and skin has become so very dry. I got the skin under control (La La retro and Wonderwild), I had been wanting a hair mask. Literally forgot I had this sampler! So glad I found it in my stash!! DEFINITE RECOMMEND! Super soft but full of volume (I have fine straight hair).

avis.titre: The best conditioner I've ever used
avis.texte: I can't believe how well this works. I have thick curly color treated hair and it's dry. This conditions and hydrates and makes my hair feel like silk. My teenage son uses it too. We love it. Nothing compares.
I liked this shampoo. My hair is soft and manageable. The scent is subtle.
All of my other products are amazing and I love them but one of my mini serum bottles was all dried up so I had to throw it out. Not very happy about that

I have naturally curly color treated hair. The ends of my hair have become frizzy and dry in this Colorado climate. This made no difference. So disappointed considering all the other reviews. Skip this.

So, I've used this product a couple of times. I find it difficult to squeeze the container to get the shampoo out. Seems like it could be put in a tube, like the Moisturizing Mask or even a softer plastic squeeze bottle? Will not be purchasing this product again.

I love whole products from the Silkamino line, including this hair mask. The scent is light but delightful. I like this mask is in a tube but not a jar so that water will not go inside of it. My hair definitely looks smoother and shinier than before.

This mask was fine. I have a whole review for it. But came to say that the packaging quality is AWFUL. The edge of the plastic is so sharp and it was so difficult to open the lid that I actually cut my hand on it while trying to get it opened in the shower. So absolutely dangerous. Just psa for anyone considering this and doesn't want to deal with bad packaging!

I'm in love with the Drunk Elephant Silkamino Mega-Moisturizing Masker and how it's helped nourished and moisturized my damaged hair! I apply after shampooing, starting at end working my way up to roots and leave in for about 5 minutes for regular treatment and for an intense deeper treatment I'll leave it in for 25 minutes. This really is a deep conditioning mask that really works wonders to moisturize and hydrate your hair, smooth, add shine, reduce frizz, repair damage, prevent my color hair dye from fading a major plus, and overall give my hair a healthier look and feel to it. My hair really has started to look healthier from the damage and really does feel so too I love touching it and it feeling so soft!
Wonderful! Pampers my fine hair just as beautifully as the Mega-Moisturizing Shampoo! Love and thank you for this product as well!
Omgosh! If you have frail, dry, damaged hair get this!!!! This stuff worked in just one application. I now use it once weekly. Love it!
I have thin curly hair and this deep moisturizer makes it so easy to detangle my hair. New favorite!!

I recently dyed my hair for the first time and had a horrible experience. I first tried some products from another company and my hair was very angry. I panicked and remembered that I purchased this. After using as directed, the ball of hay on head melted like butter. Thanks for rescuing me DE.

I'm returning it because it wasn't what I was told. I told the associate I needed deep conditioning & to help with breakage due to medication I was taking. I believe they were trying to promote this product to get incentives and didn't care.
Makes it very easy to comb out my thin curly hair. I like that it's not watery but yet it is easy to apply.
I have fine platinum blonde hair. This is light weight and doesn't leave any build up to discolor my hair.
I have really never used a shampoo and conditioner that immediately made my hair look and feel healthier until I used these products...

I'm now on my second bottle, this mask is extremely hydrating and helps my hair stay tangle free and manageable. It is a must for my hair care, one of the better investments I've made in regards to learning how to care for my thick curly hair!
Intoxicating scent. Deeply nourishing. No frills. And somehow this all combined into a product I actually look forward to using on hair wash days.

I thought I was in love with Cocomino shampoo and conditioner and along came Silkamino! Wow! Who knew it could get even better! The silky, smooth, hydrated hair that I have after using this shampoo is what hair dreams are made of. And the new moisturizing mask is perfect. Literally perfect. Thank you DE!

I tried this and was unsure how I felt about the results. I ended up getting a return which drunk elephant was gracious enough to let me keep the products so I decided to give this another shot over the course of a week. After a week using this along with the matching shampoo I can honestly say my hair hasn't looked better. I've been silicone free for years now so there was no transition period to worry about. My hair is curly and bright hot pink and this conditioner has calmed my frizz and defined my curls. My hair just feels normal. I even use a little as a leave In and it keeps my hair soft. It leaves an incredible shine and I'm definitely going to continue using and will buy more when I'm out. I urge everyone to give this a shot!

Before Silkamino my hair was especially dull and dry due to being over processed during a recent salon trip but after just one use I noticed an immediate change in my hair, it looks and feels healthier than it has in years!

I was really disappointed in this hair mask it doesn't really have a fragrance also when you put it on your hair it feels like it's a waxy kind of substance I feel there's not a lot of hydration in it it's not worth the price

avis.titre: just buy it if you're tangly
avis.texte: i have fine, TANGLY, damaged, long, bleached PLATINUM roots-to-ends hair. I could immediately tell a difference with this mask. A lot of my breakage comes from detangling - now I feel like I can finally get some growth

I have a lot of allergies and need products that won't irritate my skin with fragrances or essential oils. This has some kind of vanilla extract in it (but no fragrance). It smells like the vanilla you use when baking and I found it didn't bug my super sensitive skin/allergies. I have really fine, wavy hair and this made it super soft, but also didn't weigh it down at all. I found that it helped me comb through my hair super easily when I wasn't feeling well. Will definitely repurchase!

I am soooo happy with this conditioner! I got it as a sample with another Drunk Elephant purchase and I thought it would be crazy to also get their shampoo/conditioner. But after using this I probably will! It conditioned so well - no tangles at all for my thick/wavy hair. And it didn't weigh my hair down at all. Also, no frizz in hot and humid Michigan!

I got this as a sample with one of my other purchases of drunk elephant products. I was pleasantly surprised how well this nourished my hair. I have super frizzy hair especially in summer heat humidity and this did a great job to make it more smooth without being oily or heavy. The smell was a bit off putting but it doesn't linger.
